title: •Do They Have A Code Clearance?
caption: •Do They Have A Code Clearance? (V)
game_text: Plays on table. If opponent just retrieved Force using an Interrupt or Utinni Effect, you may place that card here. Opponent’s Force retrieval is reduced by X, where X = number of cards here.
lore: Imperial officers are always on the lookout for Rebel espionage.

notes: Unique. Banner DEFENSIVE SHIELD (slip frame: red Effect top edge fading into the teal shield frame). Printed base is a Coruscant Effect. Banner carries the GRABBER icon box at its right end (lavender box, black hand — as on the printed Coruscant Effect) → grabber true. Slip heading and caption both •; match the base. No inline icons; slip text matches the stub. Lore matches the wiki and the 745 px scan (no correction). Copyright read off the 745 px scan: 2001 SE-style line with year after the first ©. Modern: the PC's Virtual Shields remake VSh-D-dotheyhaveacodeclearancev-pre.gif (350 px). Art from the base scan, not the modern VSh shield face: the shield frame's art window is narrower and left a cyan strip down the right edge of the art box.
